pages.title: Dashboard
pages._note: Bespoke OpenRegister dashboard (DashboardIndex) with OR-specific widgets and stores; not expressible as a built-in dashboard widget grid.

pages.title: Registers
pages._note: Register is an OpenRegister foundation entity served by its own controller/store, not a register-stored object; the built-in index renderer (useObjectStore by register+schema slug) cannot resolve it.

pages.title: Register
pages._note: Register foundation entity detail; no register+schema slug for the built-in detail renderer.

pages.title: Schemas
pages._note: Schema is an OpenRegister foundation entity served by its own controller/store, not a register-stored object; the built-in index renderer cannot resolve it.

pages.title: Schema
pages._note: Schema foundation entity detail with a bespoke property/configuration editor; no register+schema slug for the built-in detail renderer.

pages.title: Data sources
pages._note: Source is an OpenRegister foundation entity served by its own controller/store, not a register-stored object.

pages.title: Organisations
pages._note: Tenant-aware organisation management with bespoke widgets; not a generic object list.

pages.title: Applications
pages._note: Application (virtual app) is an OpenRegister foundation entity served by its own controller/store, not a register-stored object.

pages.title: Application
pages._note: Application foundation entity detail; no register+schema slug for the built-in detail renderer.

pages.title: Objects
pages._note: Cross-register object browser with bespoke filters; there is no single register+schema slug for the built-in index renderer to target.

pages.title: Object
pages._note: Reuses ObjectsIndex with a {register,schema,id} param-watch that primes objectStore for the deep-link; forcing the built-in detail renderer would change this behaviour.

pages.title: Search / views
pages._note: Faceted cross-schema search via OR's bespoke SearchIndex; the built-in search page would change behaviour.

pages.title: AI Chat
pages._note: Bespoke realtime AI chat shell wired to OR's conversation store; not the library's generic chat page.

pages.title: Files
pages._note: Files workspace, not a standard object list.

pages.title: Agents

pages.title: Configurations

pages.title: Deleted

pages.title: Audit Trails

pages.title: Search Trails

pages.title: Webhooks

pages._note: Entity foundation entity detail; no register+schema slug for the built-in detail renderer.
